六级大纲词汇 · 15英文原文

A Parcel Through the Ash

穿过火山灰的包裹 · 591 词 · 7 段 · 首次出现的目标词加粗

1An eruption closed an airstrip on a tropical isle. A scientific expedition was camped on a humid plateau above a gorge. It was comparing the volcano with a retreating glacier. In the morning panorama its tents looked like a strip of pale cloth. By noon ash enveloped them. A satellite image covering half the hemisphere showed the plume moving toward the equator. Mae could fly a radio and medical kit in. First she had to ascertain where to release them.

2A steward on a grounded liner relayed a message. The camp had moved twice, which seemed to baffle the controller. A researcher had fractured an ankle near a trench. An auxiliary boat could escort the group out from a sheltered cape once the swell eased. A glider could reach the plateau with no propeller to foul, but landing on unfamiliar terrain was too dangerous. Mae planned an airborne drop. She aligned two bearings on the map. The optimum course would follow an arc well outside the ash.

3They packed the fragile radio in a rigid capsule. The rig used a symmetrical pair of straps, with enough elasticity to hold the load through a turn. On the ground an engineer compressed a pad and used it to simulate the shock of landing. A gauge on the capsule would show whether the impact had exceeded its threshold. Mae rehearsed when to eject it. A premature ejection would send it into the gorge. The test gave her a clear point at which to abort.

4Aloft, the plane met turbulent air. Mae heard the engine howl in the gusts. A ridge hid the plume's lower edge. Dust began to flutter against the glass. Mae could see a strip of land off the wing and used it to deviate from the planned course. A sudden rotation let the capsule slide toward its hatch. One elastic strap had snapped. The assistant caught it on a buffer pad and fixed a replacement. The rigidity of its outer case mattered now. The radio remained intact.

5At the depot a receiver amplified the expedition's signal. Through extra amplification its operator heard a report of a white dome, a stark saddle, and a burnt patch of shrubbery. Mae recognized a disused weather station. The convergence of two bearings placed it just west of the trench. Three people below waved cloth frantically. The wind made loose ash whirl. A parachute would drift beyond the group if she aimed at the dome. Mae allowed for the drift. The capsule landed beside the station, just short of the trench. The crew recorded the change in its longitudinal position.

6A fresh signal gave the rescue boat clearance to approach. The crew found the group huddled on the saddle. Rather than grope across the flooded path, they followed a line the researchers had marked above it. They hoisted the injured man and took everyone to a haven below the cape. Forty minutes elapsed before the boat confirmed the retrieval and Mae returned. The ash and the current had hampered the evacuation, yet everyone was accounted for.

7A week later the man brought a piece of parachute cloth to the airstrip. Mae kept it beside the map. The new drill required each crew to adhere to the planned abort point, irrespective of the pressure to complete a drop. A robust logistical plan still mattered. The failed strap gave them an impetus to test each fastener. The drill also made them practice deviating from the route. She pointed to the cloth when asked what had made the difference.

六级大纲词汇 · 15中文译文

穿过火山灰的包裹

按英文段落顺序对照阅读

1一座热带岛屿火山喷发，简易机场被迫关闭。科考队扎营在峡谷上方的潮湿高地，正在把这座火山和一条退缩的冰川作比较。早上的全景里，帐篷像一溜浅色布条。到了中午，火山灰把它们盖住了。覆盖半个半球的卫星图显示，灰柱正移向赤道。飞行员梅可以空运一部电台和一套医疗用品进去，先得确定投放地点。

2一艘搁浅客轮上的服务员转来一条消息，营地竟然已经转移了两次，调度员一时不知该信哪个位置。一名研究人员在沟谷旁摔断了脚踝。海浪小一点后，一艘辅助船可以从背风的海岬接走科考队。滑翔机没有会被灰堵住的螺旋桨，能飞到高地，但在陌生地形降落太危险。梅决定空投。她在地图上对齐两条方位线。最佳航线是一条离灰云足够远的弧线。

3他们把易损的电台放进硬质投放舱，用一对对称的带子固定。带子有弹性，飞机转弯时也能稳住载荷。地面工程师压紧一个缓冲垫，模拟着地时的冲击。舱上的仪表会显示冲击有没有超过阈值。梅演练了在什么时刻释放舱体。放早了，它就会掉进峡谷。这次测试让她明确了什么情况下必须中止投放。

4升空后，飞机遇到乱流。梅听见发动机在阵风中发出呼啸。山脊挡住了灰柱的下缘，细灰飘到舷窗上。梅看到机翼外的一条陆地，以它为参照偏离原路线。飞机突然一转，投放舱滑向舱门。一根弹力带断了，助手用缓冲垫接住舱体，换上一根新带。外壳够硬，里面的电台完好无损。

5调度站的接收设备放大了科考队的信号。操作员从增强的信号中听见几个地标，白色圆顶、光秃的山坳，还有一片烧过的灌木。梅认出那是一座废弃气象站。两条方位线的交点就在沟谷西边。下面有三个人急切地挥着布。风把松散的灰卷了起来。如果对准圆顶投放，降落伞会飘过那群人。梅算上了偏移。投放舱落在站房旁，离沟边还差一点。机组记下了投放点在纵向上的偏差。

6新的电台信号让救援船得到靠近许可。船员发现科考队聚在山坳里。他们沿研究人员在高处标过的路线走，避开需要摸索着通过的积水小路。他们把伤员吊上船，带所有人去了海岬下的避风处。四十分钟后，救援船确认人已接齐，梅才返航。火山灰和水流拖慢了撤离，但最后每个人都到了安全地带。

7一周后，伤员带来一块降落伞布。梅把它放在地图旁。新的演练规定，不管多想把物资送到，到了预先设定的中止条件就得停。可靠的后勤计划依然重要。那根断带提醒他们逐个检查固定件，演练也让他们练习临时偏离路线。有人问究竟是什么改变了结果，梅就指给他看那片布。
